sentences.text: Mr. R.R. Maddalwar, Advocate for applicant.
Ms. M.R. Kavimandan, App for respondent /State.

2. The applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No. 10/2026, registered with
Police Station Samudrapur, District Wardha, for the offences punishable under Sections 123,318(4),
336(2), 336(3), 340(2), 274,275,223, 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Sections 65(e),
77(a), 83 of the Maharashtra Prohibition Act and Sections 3((1)(zz)(iv)
(v), 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv),27(i), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. Issue notice to the non applicant, returnable on 4.3.2026.
4. Learned APP waives notice on behalf of non-applicant/State.
5. The contention is that, the allegation against the applicant is that the scented tobacco and liquor which belongs to the applicant, has already been seized.
Considering the submission and the fact that the scented tobacco and the liquor has already 2 42aba129.2026...odt been recovered, prima facie, a case is made out for ad interim relief.

Hence, following order is passed:
i) Pending the application, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.
10/2026, registered with Police Station Samudrapur, District Wardha, for the offences punishable under Sections 123,318(4), 336(2), 336(3), 340(2), 274,275,223,
3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Sections 65(e), 77(a), 83 of the Maharashtra Prohibition Act and Sections 3((1)(zz)(iv)
